✗ no face recognition, no face embeddings, no identity

RT-DETRv2 Apache-2.0

PaddleOCR Apache-2.0
OpenVINO Apache-2.0

 The network clause has no "only on our
 servers" loophole and the copyleft reaches

GPU in the rack → not needed, inference is at the edge
video streamed off-site → not needed, only JSON leaves
CCTV vendor API access → not needed, our own camera
Elasticsearch 8.x → not needed, MQTT → Kafka → Postgres

Four blockers become one (privacy), and that one is far more
defensible when no video ever leaves the store." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="600" x="40" y="710" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="cam" div.div:
Why this beats the datacentre-GPU version
GPU in the rack → not needed, inference is at the edge
video streamed off-site → not needed, only JSON leaves
CCTV vendor API access → not needed, our own camera
Elasticsearch 8.x → not needed, MQTT → Kafka → Postgres
Four blockers become one (privacy), and that one is far more
defensible when no video ever leaves the store.
